settings.heading: Vast Furniture Design Services: Bringing Your Vision to Life

settings.text: At Vast Furniture, we believe that great design is a collaboration. Our professional interior design team is here to guide you from initial inspiration to final installation, ensuring every detail reflects your unique style and how you truly live.
Choose the Consultation that Fits Your Needs:

settings.title: Meet At Home
settings.text:
[Most Popular!] Your designer comes to your home, gets to know you & your real-life space, takes measurements & more.

Meet At Home

settings.title: Meet In-Store
settings.text:
Come to your nearest store to talk through your project with your designer and see furniture, decor and swatches in person.


Meet In-Store

settings.title: Meet Online
settings.text:
Hop on a video call with your designer –they’ll tour your space on-screen and guide you through ideas & options.

Meet Online

settings.heading: 1. Initial Consultation & Vision Sharing
settings.description: Start by selecting your preferred meeting format—[Meet At Home, Meet In-Store, or Meet Online]. This is where you connect with your designer, discuss your style preferences, project goals, and budget.

settings.heading: 2. Design Development & Presentation
settings.description: Your designer will use the information gathered to craft a personalized design plan. You will receive tailored proposals, including customized product suggestions, material swatches, and conceptual visuals (such as mood boards or 2D/3D layouts).

settings.heading: 3. Review & Refinement
settings.description: We present the proposed design to you for review. We then collaborate to refine details, confirm material choices, and make any necessary adjustments until the plan perfectly matches your vision.

settings.heading: 4. Order, Delivery & Installation
settings.description: Once the design is finalized, we place your orders. Vast manages all logistics, ensuring a seamless experience that includes professional delivery, setup, and installation, allowing you to simply enjoy your beautifully transformed space.
